title: So helpful
body: Dubbii is such an amazing app and very helpful. I’m so productive during the live sessions and sometimes it’s just nice for psychological support.

title: The best! Ever App and community

title: game changer 🥰
body:
you struggle with the "the most simple tasks" (compared to social standards)?
with Dubbii you find support, encouragement, compassion, step by step videos, live body doubling sessions and reminders.
but also an amazing amount of floufs aka cats dogs and other pets 🐶🐱,  puzzle nerds, space nerds 🚀, plant nerds und much more...
author: happy island
